name: Integrated telescope artificial-star optical alignment near 37 K
plain_name: Integrated telescope artificial-star optical alignment near 37 K
description: Test the complete primary-secondary-instrument optical train under cryogenic vacuum; this is an end-to-end telescope measurement rather than a single mirror surface test.

sources.citation: NASA Apollo-Era Test Chamber Now James Webb Space Telescope Ready

requirements.rationale: The chamber source identifies approximately 37 K as Webb's operating test regime; encoded 37 K is a nominal point.
Artificial-star alignment through the complete telescope is indispensable.
Cryogenic optical testing is performed under vacuum.

missing_information: The nominal 37 K point is not a tolerance band. Full alignment error budget, chamber geometry, metrology calibration and vibration isolation are not proven by these scalar checks.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
